notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) MercilessLunge_Trail_MultiDissolve_Emissive_FxM: unlit translucent two-sided Cloudburst/Ascension ribbon trails (46 enabled ribbon emitters, 68 instances in materials.json, all BLEND_Translucent/MSM_Unlit/two-sided, so not a template). SOURCE: every scalar/switch/texture listed in 'u' (instance values, root defaults as fallbacks), the root's DynamicParameter names (Scale/MotionInfluence, Opacity, Fade In, Lifetime), the fixed curve atlas rows MercilessLunge_Trail_Inner_FxCC / _Outter_FxCC (keys decoded and baked into the shader), function shells MF_BR_Dissolver_Partikel x6 (SmoothStep), MF_BR_UV_Controller ('Random Noisy Shape'), MF_PannerRotatorFPS, LinearGradient x4 ('Uses UV Channel 0'), CameraDepthFade, MF_DropTrailRibbonFade, WorldPositionOffset pin connected. UV SETS (UE4 Cascade ribbons): TexCoord0 = U 0 (head) -> 1 (tail) over the whole trail; TexCoord1 = the 2nd UV set tiled by TypeDataRibbon TilingDistance ('the (estimated) covered distance to tile the 2nd UV set at', 0 = same as TexCoord0). In the lab TexCoord0 = (UV2.y, UV.y) and TexCoord1 = UV (cascade.gd: distance / TilingDistance). Static switch 'UV1' (explicitly true on 10 instances, used by #240 and #255) moves both textures to TexCoord1; off (the other 44 emitters) they use TexCoord0, so 'Dissolve Tilin U' / 'EmissiveTextureTileU' are repeats per trail. Consistency: all 10 UV1-on instances pan U by 0..-0.2 (a world-anchored distance-tiled set needs no scroll), all 58 UV1-off ones by -0.3..-1.5 (e.g. MI_DeathlyDescent_SoftTrail_AG UV1 -0.1 vs _CB -0.7, same tiling). The trail gradient and the WPO wave use TexCoord0. TEXTURE EVIDENCE: trail strips along U; R = web pattern masked to the band, G = soft band, B = full voronoi (MercilessLunge/ArcaneCurse/Rebellious/Venerated sets); MainTrail_B overrides Erosion=B, BaseAlpha=G. sRGB: 17 of the 22 referenced textures are cooked SRGB=false; RainbowTrail02_FXT, T_ArcaneCurse_Gradient, T_WizenedSage_Willowy_Smoke, UncannyAura/Textures/B and T_FracNoise_02 have no SRGB=false (UE default sRGB, decoded on sample) but are sampled raw here. DYNAMIC-PARAM EVIDENCE: 'Fade In' curves end at 0.5..1 while BallTrail keeps alpha/opacity 1 => dissolve threshold; 'Scale' 50 on Hard trails whose colour is ~0.05..0.26 => emissive multiplier; 'Lifetime' shaped (ease-out) only on the three BallTrail emitters, whose two instances are the only curve-colour ones => curve InputTime; Border params tuned only on those => border carries the Outer colour. AUTHORED (see shader header): dissolver = smoothstep(d, d+1-Contrast, mix(BaseAlpha, Erosion, Erocion Influence)); border ring = second dissolve at d + BorderScale*mix(1, FadeMult, d); masked emissive = dissolve of EmissiveTexture at max(d*DissolveEmissiveTexture, Min), ^Pow, *Intensity, only in the ring when 'Border Emissive Erode'; trail masks along TexCoord0 (base ramp g*Contrast/Length, tail ramp (1-g)*Contrast/Length, Scale = strength, Min Alpha = floor); WPO world-Y sine only when 'Offset'; MF_DropTrailRibbonFade not applied. LIBRARY GAPS (blocking exactness, not edited): (1) cascade.gd gives ribbons no dynamic parameters (particle.gdshaderinc sets v_dyn = 1 for trails; _render_ribbon computes 'extra' but never uploads it), so trails use proxies built from the source emitters' own curves at the point's relative time, per group the material can tell apart: G_CURVES = 'Use Curves for Doble Color' instances (only the 3 BallTrail emitters #292 x2 / #505 use them; their curves are identical, so exact: Scale 1, Opacity 1, Fade In, ease-out Lifetime); G_DOUT = slot 3 named 'Dissolve Out' (the 7 Magic/Ghostly Fire trails: Scale 1, median Opacity/Fade In); G_LIFE = the other 36 (median Opacity/Fade In, Scale 3 = median, so the six Scale-50 Hard/Bright trails read 17x too dim and the 0->2 centre rays slightly off; Lifetime = relative time, exact). A lab stand-in, not source behaviour; trail_dyn_proxy=false switches to real v_dyn once the library passes them. (2) materials.json stores channel masks as {ParameterValue: [r,g,b,a]}; fx_materials.gd 'v4' only accepts arrays, so the 21 overrides (EmissiveErosion=B on 19 instances, Erosion=B + BaseAlpha=G on MainTrail_B) currently fall back to the UE default R. (3) No per-texture sRGB flag (the five sRGB textures above read brighter). (4) LAB COVERAGE: 40 of the 46 ribbons are local_space=True with a constant (or no) StartLocation and no velocity, so cascade.gd collapses them to zero length; the 5 world-space Magic/Ghostly Fire trails draw nothing with either material (same-session off/on renders: 0 changed pixels); only the two MagatamaTrail emitters (#292, TrailSource+velocity) draw a real trail surface. On the 16 collapsed ribbons whose instance has 'Offset' on (#225, #235, #240, #255, #291, #462, #474 Dark Soft A, #494, #495, #514) the WPO wave stretches the zero-length strip into a thin vertical band: those lines are an artifact of the collapse, not the material's look, and say nothing about it. The material is therefore judged on an offline numpy port of this shader over a straight ribbon: captures/fam/trail_multi_dissolve_preview/ (trail_preview.py; preview_fixed.png / preview_key_fixed.png: pre-review mapping | Godot now | exact dyn + channel masks + sRGB). Same-session lab off/on: captures/fam/trail_multi_dissolve_fixed/onoff_same_session.png and zoom_292_off_old_fixed.png.
